// gitRead corpus for the exec-output taint engine
// (TestGitReadContentIsNotCleared). gitTrim's marker is true only for the ref
// invocations it is pinned to. A patch body read through the unmarked gitRead —
// verifyscope's `git diff -U0` shape — and quoted into a returned error is a
// finding whose origin is gitRead's spawn; a SHA read through gitTrim is clean.
package gitread

import (
	"fmt"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

func gitTrim(repoDir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	out, err := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", repoDir}, args...)...).Output()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	//dross:taint-cleared gitTrim runs only pinned ref invocations: ref names, object ids and counts
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
}

func gitRead(repoDir string, args ...string) (string, error) {
	out, err := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", repoDir}, args...)...).Output()
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), nil
}

func hunkScope(repoDir, sha string) error {
	patch, err := gitRead(repoDir, "diff", "-U0", "--no-renames", "--no-color", sha, "HEAD")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(patch, "diff --git") {
		return fmt.Errorf("unexpected patch: %s", patch) // WANT taint
	}
	return nil
}

func headSHA(repoDir string) error {
	head, err := gitTrim(repoDir, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("HEAD is %s", head)
}
